notes: All 43 events are historically real. Two factual precision issues flagged (see events 3 and 40). No FALSE events. QA-flagged 22-yr gap 1932→1954 is a valid gap in the file — Holodomor (1932) and Crimea transfer (1954) both verify correctly; no WWII or Stalinist-thaw events exist in the file, which is the coverage gap.

events.title: Holodomor: Soviet-Engineered Famine in Ukraine
events.note: Death toll 3.5–7.5M confirmed by multiple scholarly sources. Year 1932 correct (famine 1932–33). Category and framing accurate.

events.title: Chernobyl Nuclear Disaster
events.note: Date April 26 1986 confirmed. Evacuation figure '116,000' matches (NRC says 115,000 — acceptable rounding). '$700 billion cleanup cost' is the USC/total-economic-cost estimate, not the direct cleanup cost alone — description should clarify 'total economic cost' not 'cleanup cost'. Flag for editorial review, not a falsehood.
